p: be like a strong wind: He declares that their words which would diminish anything from the justice of God, are but as a puff of wind that vanishes away.
transgression: That is, has rewarded them according to their iniquity, meaning that Job should be warned by the example of his children, that he not offend God.
wouldest seek unto God betimes: That is, if you turn while God calls you to repentance.
was small: Though the beginning is not as pleasant as you would like, yet in the end you will have sufficient opportunity to please yourself.
enquire: He wills Job to examine all antiquity and he will find it true which he here says.
yesterday: Meaning, that it is not enough to have the experience of ourselves, but to be confirmed by the examples of those who went before us.
grow up without mire: As a rush cannot grow without moisture, so the hypocrite because he does not have faith which is watered with God's Spirit.
spider's web: Which is today and tomorrow swept away.
green before the sun: He compares the just to a tree, which although it is moved from one place to another, yet flourishes: so the affliction of the godly turns to their profit.
deny him: That is, so that there remains nothing there to prove whether the tree had grown there or not.
of his way: To be planted in another place, where it may grow as it pleases.
laughing: If you are godly, he will give you opportunity to rejoice and if not your affliction will increase.
